package domain

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

const (
	turnStudentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	turnCommandID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	turnDialogID  = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	turnTeacherID = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	turnMessageID = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
	turnEventID   = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
	turnJobID     = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	turnExecution = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
)

func TestNormalizeStudentOnboardingTurnCanonicalizesIdentityAndOrdersTypedSlots(t *testing.T) {
	confidence := 5000
	minutes := 300
	direction := " Backend "
	command := validTextTurnCommand()
	command.StudentID = strings.ToUpper(turnStudentID)
	command.Slots = []StudentOnboardingTurnSlot{
		{SlotCode: StudentOnboardingSlotWeeklyMinutes, IntegerValue: &minutes, Origin: StudentOnboardingTurnOriginExplicitText, ConfidenceBasisPoints: &confidence},
		{SlotCode: StudentOnboardingSlotDirectionCode, CodeValue: &direction, Origin: StudentOnboardingTurnOriginExplicitText, ConfidenceBasisPoints: &confidence},
	}
	normalized, err := NormalizeStudentOnboardingTurn(command)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("normalize: %v", err)
	}
	if normalized.StudentID != turnStudentID || normalized.Slots[0].SlotCode != StudentOnboardingSlotDirectionCode ||
		normalized.Slots[1].SlotCode != StudentOnboardingSlotWeeklyMinutes || *normalized.Slots[0].CodeValue != "backend" {
		t.Fatalf("identity/slots were not canonical: %+v", normalized)
	}
}

func TestNormalizeStudentOnboardingTurnRejectsNonAcceptedOriginsAndInvalidConfidence(t *testing.T) {
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(*StudentOnboardingTurnCommand)
	}{
		{name: "inferred", mutate: func(command *StudentOnboardingTurnCommand) {
			command.Slots[0].Origin = StudentOnboardingTurnOriginInferred
		}},
		{name: "default reserved", mutate: func(command *StudentOnboardingTurnCommand) {
			command.Slots[0].SlotCode = StudentOnboardingSlotPreferredLanguage
			language, rule := "ru", AuthenticatedUILocaleDefaultRule
			command.Slots[0].CodeValue, command.Slots[0].DefaultRuleCode = &language, &rule
			command.Slots[0].Origin, command.Slots[0].ConfidenceBasisPoints = StudentOnboardingTurnOriginDefault, nil
		}},
		{name: "text too high", mutate: func(command *StudentOnboardingTurnCommand) {
			value := 10001
			command.Slots[0].ConfidenceBasisPoints = &value
		}},
		{name: "ui not certain", mutate: func(command *StudentOnboardingTurnCommand) {
			action, confidence := "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", 9999
			command.ActionReceiptID, command.AIExecutionID = &action, nil
			command.CorrelationID, command.CausationID = action, turnJobID
			command.Slots[0].Origin, command.Slots[0].ConfidenceBasisPoints = StudentOnboardingTurnOriginExplicitUI, &confidence
		}},
		{name: "bad dialog causation", mutate: func(command *StudentOnboardingTurnCommand) { command.DialogCausationID = turnEventID }},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			command := validTextTurnCommand()
			testCase.mutate(&command)
			if _, err := NormalizeStudentOnboardingTurn(command); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("expected validation failure")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestNormalizeStudentOnboardingTurnFinalizationRetainsV1Boundary(t *testing.T) {
	command := validTextTurnCommand()
	profile := int64(0)
	command.FinalizeCurrentV1, command.ExpectedProfileVersion = true, &profile
	command.ExpectedDraftVersion = 0
	if _, err := NormalizeStudentOnboardingTurn(command); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("v0 finalization must be rejected")
	}
	command.ExpectedDraftVersion = 1
	if _, err := NormalizeStudentOnboardingTurn(command); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("S3 only validates the transition envelope; v1 completeness belongs to finalization: %v", err)
	}
}

func validTextTurnCommand() StudentOnboardingTurnCommand {
	confidence := 5000
	direction := "backend"
	return StudentOnboardingTurnCommand{
		Schema: StudentOnboardingTurnSchema, StudentID: turnStudentID, StudentCommandID: turnCommandID,
		DialogID: turnDialogID, PersonalTeacherID: turnTeacherID, TeacherTurnSequence: 1,
		CanonicalStudentMessageID: turnMessageID, SourceEventID: turnEventID, DialogCausationID: turnMessageID,
		TeacherJobID: turnJobID, AIExecutionID: stringPtr(turnExecution), CorrelationID: turnMessageID, CausationID: turnExecution,
		ExpectedDraftVersion: 0, Slots: []StudentOnboardingTurnSlot{{
			SlotCode: StudentOnboardingSlotDirectionCode, CodeValue: &direction, Origin: StudentOnboardingTurnOriginExplicitText,
			ConfidenceBasisPoints: &confidence,
		}},
		OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 9, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
}

func stringPtr(value string) *string { return &value }
